body_validation: Single JSON kind5 TLV, <=256 bytes, message.body exactly equals encoded TLV
json_validation: Exact five keys, duplicate rejection, integer ABI1, exact identity/result/presentation,40 lowercase ASCII hex; optional one trailing NUL
state_validation: flags only0..7; hidden/seen/resync0..1; reserved byte17 zero; no cross-field inference
correlation: service15/cmd7d always; expectedEvent checked when supplied
limitations: Native-v1 differs from G2 overlay fonts/layout/lifetime.
